lesson-intro.text: Think of a beach. There's a palm tree on it, leaning toward the sea. Watch its leaves spill over like a fountain, then draw the palm on your own beach.

trunk-left.text: The trunk leans to the right. From the ground, draw one long curve up to the top.

trunk-right.text: Now a flat foot to the right. From its end, draw a second curve up, closer at the top.

rings.text: Four short curved lines cross the trunk like little smiles. They stop before the edges.

top-leaf.text: A palm leaf is an arch with a saw under it. Arch up and over to the right, then zigzag back.

upper-left-leaf.text: Now a long leaf to the left. Arch out to its tip, then saw your way back to the trunk.

upper-right-leaf.text: Its partner reaches out to the right, the same way: arch first, teeth second.

lower-left-leaf.text: A shorter leaf droops under the left one. Curve out and down, then zigzag home.

lower-right-leaf.text: One last drooping leaf on the right finishes the crown.

leaves-green.text: Color the top leaf and the two drooping ones green.

side-leaves.text: The two long side leaves are dark green.

lesson-outro.text: Five leaves and a leaning trunk. You can almost hear the waves.
